| Category = Meat recipes
| Difficulty = 2
}}

{{recipe}}

A relatively simple recipe for baked pork chops.

==Ingredients==

* 3–4 bone-in [[Cookbook:Pork|pork]] chops, ¼ [[Cookbook:Inch|inch]] (6 [[Cookbook:Mm|mm]]) thin
* 1 medium [[Cookbook:Apple|apple]], cored and [[Cookbook:Slicing|sliced]] thin
* 1 medium [[Cookbook:Onion|onion]], sliced thin
* 1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoon]] (15 [[Cookbook:Milliliter|ml]]) [[Cookbook:Honey|honey]]
* 1 tablespoon (15 ml) [[Cookbook:Caraway|caraway seed]] (can be salvaged from the bag your rye bread comes in)
* [[Cookbook:Garlic Salt|Garlic salt]], [[Cookbook:pepper|black pepper]], and [[Cookbook:Dijon Mustard|Dijon mustard]], to taste

==Procedure==

# Heat [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] to 350 °F (180 °C)
# Layer sliced onion and apple in a baking dish that can be covered; drizzle honey and half the caraway over apple and onion slices
# Season meat with garlic salt and pepper; spread top of meat with Dijon
# Sprinkle remainder of caraway
# Cover and [[Cookbook:Baking|bake]] for one hour.
